inputs.retained_edges: HGB_K8/retained_mask.npy, aligned with HGB_positive_candidate_indices.npy and candidate_row_mapping.parquet; edge mask, not a record mask
inputs.partitions_only: private/lineage.jsonl: extract record_id and partition only during construction

construction.U: Every unordered distinct record pair within each frozen HGB K8 component, including pairs outside candidates and without relation labels. No graph modifications.
construction.U_rest: U minus U_test, including any cross-partition pairs
construction.ordering: Canonical endpoints lexicographically ascending; sort all pairs by endpoint IDs. Stable pair_id derived directly from endpoint IDs, without hashes.
construction.pair_pilot: Run all original 400 in original order and original endpoint orientation; reuse public caption inputs, checking equality with PAIR_PILOT_RUN sample bytes. Report K8 membership independently; only intersecting U_test rows count toward U_test coverage.
construction.budget_gate: Independently compute component size counts and U; any disagreement with supplied budget stops execution and is reported, without changing inputs or definitions.

prompt.implementation: scripts/run_vlm_pilot.py build_prompt_record/build_qwen_messages, as used by scripts/run_caption_action_eval.py
prompt.parser: scripts/caption_action/reference.py strict_parse, unchanged; final z_e is parsed.decision

1a.reason: Match PAIR_PILOT_RUN single-pair submission, prompt order and endpoint orientation

2.deadline_policy: Check before each 5000-pair lease; once admitted finish that batch and release GPU at batch boundary

resume: Durably record submitted pair identities before generate. Append terminal rows once, including failures, never retry terminal attempts. An unresolved admitted batch stops for reconciliation; never silently resubmit it.

evaluation.reference_gate: Do not open sealed relation reference until all U_test pairs have terminal outputs. Existing published budgets are not newly observed references.
evaluation.reference_budget_gate: Independently compute co-member test same=8698, same FN=3, M=297, L1=HN=0. Stop/report any discrepancy before claim updates.
evaluation.confusion: TP=M mismatch; FN=M other final action; FP=same mismatch; TN=same other final action. Contract-invalid/runtime-failed rows have final uncertain and are separately reported; no reference label is fabricated.
evaluation.metrics: P=TP/(TP+FP), R=TP/(TP+FN), F1=2TP/(2TP+FP+FN); zero denominator gives null. Also report FP with negatives limited to L2/L3.
evaluation.distribution: Five final decisions duplicate/non_duplicate/keep_augment/mismatch/uncertain by L0, L2, L3, M and unlabeled. Counts conserve U_test. L1/HN if observed trigger budget stop.
evaluation.keep_augment: Count z_e=keep_augment separately within L2, L3, L0; descriptive actions, not complementarity accuracy or final information loss.
evaluation.repeatability: All400 exact final decision agreements, full5x5 cross-tab; per-class matching counts; keep_augment both positive, both negative, binary agreement, old/new positive counts. Report K8 membership of original400.
evaluation.no_reselection: No prompts, grids, concurrency or parser revisions from test results; no graph repair or deletion evaluation. Preserve historical test exposure.

cost: Separate1a/1b/2: submitted model requests, runtime failures, parse/contract failures, terminal counts, inference batch wall seconds, GPU session wall seconds including model load, session seconds/submitted pair. Do not sum shared batch latency per row. GPU lock wait excluded. Preserve failed/incomplete sessions separately.

coordination.gpu: Acquire shared flock; inspect nvidia-smi before loading. All GPU imports/load/generate/process lifetime inside flock. Release between phase2 batches.
coordination.phase1_handoff: After complete U_test evaluation and results(stage_e_clusters) test commit, atomically write resource phase1_complete.json listing verdict files, row counts and commit for RETAINED_AUDIT_RUN. Never publish completion on partial or failed gates.

provenance: Named paths, exact endpoint identities/order, counts and sizes; no new file hashes. Do not modify frozen inputs, response_text, human originals or32B/38B files.
